senses.definition: not anyone; no person

examples.x: No one was at home.
There was no one else around.
We were told to speak to no one.

senses.definition_vi: không một ai; không một người nào

senses.definition: the quality or fact of being very fat, in a way that is not healthy

examples.x: Obesity can increase the risk of heart disease.

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng hoặc sự thật của việc quá béo, theo cách không lành mạnh

senses.definition: to do what you are told or expected to do

examples.x: to obey a command/an order/rules/the law
He was arrested when he failed to obey a police instruction to stop.
He has turned into an efficient soldier, blindly obeying orders (= without questioning them).
He had always obeyed his parents without question.
I tried to run but my legs just wouldn't obey me.
‘Sit down!’ Meekly, she obeyed.

senses.definition_vi: làm những gì bạn được yêu cầu hoặc mong đợi

senses.definition: a thing that can be seen and touched, but is not alive

examples.x: everyday objects such as cups and saucers
inanimate objects (= things that are not alive)
a physical/material object (= that you can see and touch)
The scanner detected a metal object.
We now know that solid objects are largely made up of empty space.
art objects from the ancient world

senses.definition_vi: một thứ có thể nhìn thấy và chạm vào, nhưng không sống

senses.definition: a person or thing that somebody desires, studies, pays attention to, etc.

examples.x: He felt he was nothing more to her than an object of desire.
Her objects of study are all paintings.
an object of affection/ridicule/worship

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật mà ai đó mong muốn, nghiên cứu, chú ý đến, v.v.

senses.definition: an aim or a purpose

examples.x: Her sole object in life is to become a travel writer.
The object is to educate people about road safety.
The object of the game is to score points by combining cards.
If you're late, you'll defeat the whole object of the exercise.

examples.cf: with the object of doing something
examples.x: He put together an army with the object of taking back the lost territory.

senses.definition_vi: một mục tiêu hoặc một mục đích

senses.definition: a noun, noun phrase or pronoun that refers to a person or thing that is affected by the action of the verb (called the direct object), or that the action is done to or for (called the indirect object)
senses.definition_vi: một danh từ, cụm danh từ hoặc đại từ đề cập đến một người hoặc vật bị ảnh hưởng bởi hành động của động từ (gọi là tân ngữ trực tiếp), hoặc vật mà hành động được thực hiện cho hoặc vì (gọi là tân ngữ gián tiếp)

senses.definition: money is not something that needs to be considered, because there is plenty of it available

examples.x: She travels around the world as if money is no object.

senses.definition_vi: tiền bạc không phải là thứ cần được xem xét, vì có rất nhiều sẵn có

senses.definition: to say that you disagree with or oppose something

examples.x: If nobody objects, we'll postpone the meeting till next week.
Members of the council strongly objected to plans to sell off the land.
Many local people object to the building of the new airport.
I really object to being charged for parking.
Who could object to people having fun?

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn không đồng ý hoặc phản đối điều gì đó

senses.definition: to give something as a reason for opposing something

examples.x: He objected that the police had arrested him without sufficient evidence.
‘But that's not fair!’ she objected.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra một điều gì đó làm lý do để phản đối điều gì đó

senses.definition: a reason why you do not like or are opposed to something; a statement about this

examples.x: I'd like to come too, if you have no objection.
They raised no objections at the time.
He did not know how to voice his objections.
The main objection to the plan was that it would cost too much.
There was widespread objection to the proposals.
I have no objection to him coming to stay.
I have no objection to staying here.
The proposal will go ahead despite strong objections from the public.
He dismissed the objection that the plan was too expensive.

senses.definition_vi: một lý do khiến bạn không thích hoặc phản đối điều gì đó; một tuyên bố về điều này

senses.definition: not influenced by personal feelings or opinions; considering only facts

examples.x: an objective assessment of the situation
objective truth/facts/reality
objective criteria/measures/measurements
He doesn't even pretend to be impartial and objective.
It's hard to remain completely objective.

senses.definition_vi: không bị ảnh hưởng bởi cảm xúc hoặc ý kiến cá nhân; chỉ xem xét các sự kiện

senses.definition: existing outside the mind; based on facts that can be proved

examples.x: objective reality

senses.definition_vi: tồn tại bên ngoài tâm trí; dựa trên các sự kiện có thể chứng minh được

senses.definition: the objective case is the one which is used for the object of a sentence
senses.definition_vi: trường hợp được sử dụng cho tân ngữ của câu

senses.definition: something that you are trying to achieve

examples.x: the primary/principal/key objective
The main objective of this meeting is to give more information on our plans.
How does the project fit with our strategic objectives?
the government's policy objectives
to achieve/meet/accomplish your objectives
to set/state/define your objectives
You must set realistic aims and objectives for yourself.
What are the organization's goals and objectives?

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó mà bạn đang cố gắng đạt được

senses.definition: the lens in a telescope or microscope that is nearest to the object being looked at
senses.definition_vi: ống kính trong kính thiên văn hoặc kính hiển vi gần nhất với vật thể đang được nhìn

senses.definition: the state of being forced to do something because it is your duty, or because of a law, etc.

examples.x: You are under no obligation to buy anything.
She did not feel under any obligation to tell him the truth.
I don't want people coming to see me out of a sense of obligation.
We will send you an estimate for the work without obligation (= you do not have to accept it).

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng bị buộc phải làm điều gì đó vì đó là nhiệm vụ của bạn, hoặc vì luật pháp, v.v.

senses.definition: something which you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

examples.x: legal/professional/financial obligations
They reminded him of his contractual obligations.
The country has promised to comply with its international obligations.
We have a moral obligation to protect the environment.
I have an obligation under law to protect their confidentiality.
I felt that there was a moral obligation on me to tell the story.
We want to fulfil our obligation to farmers and see they get a fair price.
The company did not have enough money to meet its obligations.
We have an obligation to our consumers.

senses.definition_vi: một điều bạn phải làm vì bạn đã hứa, vì luật pháp, v.v.

senses.definition: to force somebody to do something, by law, because it is a duty, etc.

examples.x: Parents are obliged by law to send their children to school.
I felt obliged to ask them to dinner.
He suffered a serious injury that obliged him to give up work.
Libel plaintiffs are virtually obliged to go into the witness box.

senses.definition_vi: buộc ai đó phải làm điều gì đó, theo luật, vì đó là nhiệm vụ, v.v.

senses.definition: to help somebody by doing what they ask or what you know they want

examples.x: Call me if you need any help—I'd be happy to oblige.
Would you oblige me with some information?
Oblige me by keeping your suspicions to yourself.
The fans were looking for another goal and Kane duly obliged.

senses.definition_vi: giúp ai đó bằng cách làm những gì họ yêu cầu hoặc những gì bạn biết họ muốn

senses.definition: the act of watching somebody/something carefully for a period of time, especially to learn something

examples.x: Most information was collected by direct observation of the animals' behaviour.
results based on scientific observations
We managed to escape observation (= we were not seen).
The suspect is being kept under observation (= watched closely by the police).
She has outstanding powers of observation (= the ability to notice things around her).
an observation post/tower (= a place from where somebody, especially an enemy, can be watched)
an observation deck (= a room or platform at the top of a tall building which provides views of the surrounding area)
his close observations of animal life in its natural setting

senses.definition_vi: hành động theo dõi ai đó/điều gì đó cẩn thận trong một khoảng thời gian, đặc biệt là để học hỏi điều gì đó

senses.definition: a comment, especially based on something you have seen, heard or read

examples.x: May I make a personal observation?
He began by making a few general observations about the report.
She has some interesting observations on possible future developments.
her witty observations on life

senses.definition_vi: một bình luận, đặc biệt dựa trên điều gì đó bạn đã thấy, nghe hoặc đọc

senses.definition: to see or notice somebody/something

examples.x: Have you observed any changes lately?
All the characters in the novel are closely observed (= seem like people in real life).
I want you to observe all the details.
The patterns observed in our study may represent a general rule.
The police observed a man enter the bank.
They observed him entering the bank.
She observed that all the chairs were already occupied.
He was observed to follow her closely.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn thấy hoặc nhận thấy ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to watch somebody/something carefully, especially to learn more about them

examples.x: He observes keenly, but says little.
I felt he was observing everything I did.
The patients were observed over a period of several months.
an observed decrease in rainfall in the area
The program provided an opportunity to observe the effects of treatment.
The cells were observed under a microscope.
The patient should be observed for signs of an allergic reaction.
They observed how the parts of the machine fitted together.

senses.definition_vi: theo dõi ai đó/điều gì đó cẩn thận, đặc biệt là để tìm hiểu thêm về họ

senses.definition: to make a remark

examples.x: She observed that it was getting late.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra một nhận xét

senses.definition: to obey rules, laws, etc.

examples.x: Will the rebels observe the ceasefire?
The crowd observed a minute's silence (= were silent for one minute) in memory of those who had died.

senses.definition_vi: tuân theo các quy tắc, luật pháp, v.v.

senses.definition: to celebrate festivals, birthdays, etc.

examples.x: Religious festivals were always observed.

senses.definition_vi: tổ chức các lễ hội, sinh nhật, v.v.

senses.definition: a person who watches somebody/something

examples.x: According to observers, the plane exploded shortly after take-off.
To the casual observer (= somebody who does not pay much attention), the system appears confusing.
Most art forms require a contribution from the observer.

senses.definition_vi: một người xem ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: a person who attends a meeting, lesson, etc. to listen and watch but not to take part

examples.x: A team of British officials were sent as observers to the conference.

senses.definition_vi: một người tham dự một cuộc họp, bài học, v.v. để lắng nghe và quan sát nhưng không tham gia

senses.definition: a person who watches and studies particular events, situations, etc. and is therefore considered to be an expert on them

examples.x: a royal observer

senses.definition_vi: một người theo dõi và nghiên cứu các sự kiện, tình huống, v.v. cụ thể và do đó được coi là chuyên gia về chúng

senses.definition: to completely fill your mind so that you cannot think of anything else, in a way that is not reasonable or normal

examples.x: He's obsessed by computers.
She's completely obsessed with him.
The need to produce the most exciting newspaper story obsesses most journalists.

senses.definition_vi: làm đầy tâm trí bạn hoàn toàn đến mức bạn không thể nghĩ về bất cứ điều gì khác, theo cách không hợp lý hoặc bình thường

senses.definition: to be always talking or worrying about a particular thing, especially when this annoys other people

examples.x: I think you should try to stop obsessing about food.

senses.definition_vi: luôn nói hoặc lo lắng về một điều gì đó cụ thể, đặc biệt là khi điều này làm phiền người khác

senses.definition: the state in which a person’s mind is completely filled with thoughts of one particular thing or person in a way that is not reasonable or normal

examples.x: Her fear of flying is bordering on obsession.
There's a national obsession with celebrity in England.
The media's obsession with the young prince continues.

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng mà tâm trí một người hoàn toàn bị lấp đầy bởi suy nghĩ về một điều hoặc một người cụ thể theo cách không hợp lý hoặc bình thường

senses.definition: a person or thing that somebody thinks about too much

examples.x: Fitness has become an obsession with him.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật mà ai đó nghĩ về quá nhiều

senses.definition: a situation, an event, etc. that makes it difficult for you to do or achieve something

examples.x: So far, we have managed to overcome all the obstacles that have been placed in our path.
A lack of qualifications can be a major obstacle to finding a job.
The MP claims that there is now no obstacle to him standing at the next general election.
The huge distances involved have proved an obstacle to communication between villages.

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống, một sự kiện, v.v. khiến bạn khó thực hiện hoặc đạt được điều gì đó

senses.definition: an object that is in your way and that makes it difficult for you to move forward

examples.x: The area was full of streams and bogs and other natural obstacles.
He managed with difficulty to negotiate the obstacles strewn across the floor.

senses.definition_vi: một vật cản đường bạn và khiến bạn khó di chuyển về phía trước

senses.definition: a fence, etc. for a horse to jump over

examples.x: This huge open ditch forms the biggest obstacle on the course.

senses.definition_vi: một hàng rào, v.v. để ngựa nhảy qua

senses.definition: to get something, especially by making an effort

examples.x: to obtain information/data/results
I've been trying to obtain permission to publish this material.
I finally managed to obtain a copy of the report.
Further details can be obtained by writing to the above address.
To obtain the overall score, add up the totals in each column.

senses.definition_vi: có được một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là bằng nỗ lực

senses.definition: to exist

examples.x: These conditions no longer obtain.

senses.definition_vi: tồn tại

examples.x: I know you don't like her but try not to make it so obvious.

It soon became obvious that the machine did not work.
It's painfully obvious that the budget was low for this movie.
It's obvious a change is needed.
It was obvious to everyone that the child had been badly treated.
The lessons seem fairly obvious to anyone who doesn't work in the Administration.
It's obvious from what she said that something is wrong.
For obvious reasons, I'd prefer not to give my name.
The reasons for this decision were not immediately obvious.
It is blindingly obvious that there is not enough money to finance this public spending programme.
It was far from obvious how they were going to get off the island.

senses.definition_vi: dễ dàng nhìn thấy hoặc hiểu

senses.definition: that most people would think of or agree to

examples.x: She was the obvious choice for the job.
There's no obvious solution to the problem.
This seemed the most obvious thing to do.
an obvious example/answer/question

senses.definition_vi: mà hầu hết mọi người sẽ nghĩ đến hoặc đồng ý

senses.definition: not interesting, new or showing imagination; unnecessary because it is clear to everyone

examples.x: The ending was pretty obvious.
I may be stating the obvious but without more money the project cannot survive.

senses.definition_vi: không thú vị, mới lạ hoặc thể hiện sự sáng tạo; không cần thiết vì điều đó đã rõ ràng với mọi người

senses.definition: used when giving information that you expect other people to know already or agree with

examples.x: Obviously, we don't want to spend too much money.
Diet and exercise are obviously important.
I wanted to do well, obviously, but I wasn't nervous because I don't see exams as the be all and end all.
She responded 'Oh well, obviously I disagree with him'.
This massive storm obviously had a huge impact on air travellers.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi cung cấp thông tin mà bạn mong đợi người khác đã biết hoặc đồng ý

senses.definition: used to say that a particular situation or fact is easy to see or understand

examples.x: He was obviously upset.
They're obviously not coming.
‘I didn't realise it was a formal occasion.’ ‘Obviously!’ (= I can see by the way you are dressed)
This story is so obviously false that Matthew doesn't bother to refute it.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng một tình huống hoặc sự thật cụ thể dễ dàng nhận thấy hoặc hiểu được

senses.definition: a particular time when something happens

examples.x: on this/that occasion

They have been seen together on two separate occasions.
On one occasion, she called me in the middle of the night.
Only on rare occasions do I go out socially.
I can remember very few occasions when he had to cancel because of ill health.
He used the occasion to announce further tax cuts.
I have stated on numerous occasions what options are open.
Harry has mentioned this on many previous occasions.

senses.definition_vi: một thời điểm cụ thể khi một điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: a special event, ceremony or celebration

examples.x: a great/memorable/happy/momentous occasion
Turn every meal into a special occasion.
They marked the occasion (= celebrated it) with an open-air concert.
Their wedding turned out to be quite an occasion.
We expect you to dress for the occasion.
He was presented with the watch on the occasion of his retirement.
Every good wish to them on the occasion of their 40th anniversary.

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện, nghi lễ hoặc lễ kỷ niệm đặc biệt

senses.definition: a suitable time for something

examples.x: It should have been an occasion for rejoicing, but she could not feel any real joy.
These workshops provide an occasion for talking about art.
This is not a time for specifics, but an occasion for vision.
Festivals were occasions for great celebration.
I’ll speak to him about it if the occasion arises (= if I get a chance).

senses.definition_vi: một thời điểm thích hợp cho một điều gì đó

senses.definition: a reason or cause

examples.x: I've had no occasion to visit him recently.
She doesn’t have much occasion to speak French in her new job.
Her death was the occasion of mass riots.
Art here is an occasion for education and entertainment.
I'm willing to go to court over this if the occasion arises (= if it becomes necessary).

senses.definition_vi: một lý do hoặc nguyên nhân

senses.definition: sometimes but not often

examples.x: He has been known on occasion to lose his temper.

senses.definition_vi: đôi khi nhưng không thường xuyên

senses.definition: a feeling or understanding that an event is important or special

examples.x: Candles on the table gave the evening a sense of occasion.

senses.definition_vi: một cảm giác hoặc sự hiểu biết rằng một sự kiện là quan trọng hoặc đặc biệt

senses.definition: happening or done sometimes but not often

examples.x: He works for us on an occasional basis.
The occasional sweet treat won't do you any harm.
He spent five years in Paris, with occasional visits to Italy.
an occasional drinker (= a person who drinks alcohol, but not often)

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện đôi khi nhưng không thường xuyên

senses.definition: sometimes but not often

examples.x: We occasionally meet for a drink after work.
This type of allergy can very occasionally be fatal.
Only occasionally was there any doubt that they would succeed.
Johnston is an intelligent, occasionally brilliant writer.
Cook on a medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

senses.definition_vi: đôi khi nhưng không thường xuyên

senses.definition: a job or profession

examples.x: Please state your name, age and occupation below.

senses.definition_vi: một công việc hoặc nghề nghiệp

senses.definition: the way in which you spend your time, especially when you are not working

examples.x: Her main occupation seems to be shopping.

senses.definition_vi: cách bạn dành thời gian của mình, đặc biệt là khi bạn không làm việc

senses.definition: the act of moving into a country, town, etc. and taking control of it using military force; the period of time during which a country, town, etc. is controlled in this way

examples.x: the Roman occupation of Britain
The zones under occupation contained major industrial areas.
occupation forces

senses.definition_vi: hành động di chuyển vào một quốc gia, thị trấn, v.v. và kiểm soát nó bằng vũ lực; khoảng thời gian mà một quốc gia, thị trấn, v.v. bị kiểm soát theo cách này

senses.definition: the act of living in or using a building, room, piece of land, etc.

examples.x: The offices will be ready for occupation in June.
The following applies only to tenants in occupation after January 1 this year.
The level of owner occupation (= people owning their homes) has increased rapidly in the last 30 years.

senses.definition_vi: hành động sống hoặc sử dụng một tòa nhà, phòng, mảnh đất, v.v.

senses.definition: to fill or use a space, an area or an amount of time

examples.x: The bed seemed to occupy most of the room.
As the company grew, it continued to occupy more space.
Administrative work occupies half of my time.
How do you occupy your time?
Their time is fully occupied with their rigorous training regime.

senses.definition_vi: lấp đầy hoặc sử dụng một không gian, một khu vực hoặc một khoảng thời gian

senses.definition: to live or work in a room, house or building

examples.x: He occupies an office on the 12th floor.

senses.definition_vi: sống hoặc làm việc trong một căn phòng, nhà hoặc tòa nhà

senses.definition: to enter a place in a large group and take control of it, especially by military force

examples.x: The capital has been occupied by the rebel army.
Protesting students occupied the TV station.

senses.definition_vi: tiến vào một địa điểm với một nhóm lớn và kiểm soát nó, đặc biệt là bằng vũ lực quân sự

senses.definition: to fill your time or keep you busy doing something

examples.x: a game that will occupy the kids for hours
Problems at work continued to occupy his mind for some time.
She occupied herself with routine office tasks.
She occupied herself doing routine office tasks.

senses.definition_vi: lấp đầy thời gian của bạn hoặc giữ cho bạn bận rộn làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have an official job or position

examples.x: The president occupies the position for four years.
jobs that have traditionally been occupied by men

senses.definition_vi: có một công việc hoặc vị trí chính thức

senses.definition: to happen

examples.x: When exactly did the incident occur?
Something unexpected occurred.
Three major events occurred in my life that year.
These chemical changes occur naturally.
In most years more deaths occur in winter.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra

senses.definition: to exist or be found somewhere

examples.x: Sugar occurs naturally in fruit.
naturally occurring chemicals in the brain
Lemurs occur in the wild only in Madagascar.
Infected plants frequently occur in patches.
Calluses typically occur on the bottom of the feet and heel.

senses.definition_vi: tồn tại hoặc được tìm thấy ở đâu đó

senses.definition: something that happens or exists

examples.x: a common/everyday/frequent/regular occurrence
Vandalism used to be a rare occurrence here.
The program counts the number of occurrences of any word within the text.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó xảy ra hoặc tồn tại

senses.definition: the fact of something happening or existing

examples.x: the recent occurrence of skin cancer in younger patients

senses.definition_vi: việc một điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc tồn tại

senses.definition: the mass of salt water that covers most of the earth’s surface

examples.x: The ship was dredged from the depths of the ocean.
People were swimming in the ocean despite the hurricane warning.
The plane hit the ocean several miles offshore.
Our beach house is just a couple of miles from the ocean.
ships large enough to sail the open ocean
an ocean liner
a species of fish that lives on the ocean floor
El Nino is a warm ocean current that appears off the coast of Peru during the winter.
Ocean levels are rising.

senses.definition_vi: khối nước mặn bao phủ phần lớn bề mặt trái đất

senses.definition: one of the five large areas that the ocean is divided into

senses.definition_vi: trước hết là một người hoặc vật, rồi đến người hoặc vật khác, rồi đến người hoặc vật khác nữa, lên đến bất kỳ số lượng hoặc số lượng nào

senses.definition: everyone

examples.x: Happy New Year to one and all!

senses.definition_vi: mọi người

senses.definition: used to emphasize that somebody is famous

examples.x: Here she is, the one and only Rihanna!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng ai đó nổi tiếng

senses.definition: used for emphasis to mean ‘the same’

examples.x: I never realized Ruth Rendell and Barbara Vine were one and the same (= the same person using two different names).

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh với ý nghĩa 'giống nhau'

senses.definition: separately and in order

examples.x: I went through the items on the list one by one.

senses.definition_vi: riêng biệt và theo thứ tự

senses.definition: a few

examples.x: We've had one or two problems—nothing serious.

senses.definition_vi: một vài

senses.definition: having an advantage over somebody
senses.definition_vi: có lợi thế hơn ai đó

senses.definition: used to say that all types of the things mentioned are very similar

examples.x: I don't like science fiction novels much. When you've read one, you've read them all.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng tất cả các loại của những thứ được đề cập đều rất giống nhau

senses.definition: a very long time ago

examples.x: I've been going there every summer since the year one.

senses.definition_vi: rất lâu trước đây

senses.definition: used to avoid repeating a noun, when you are referring to somebody/something that has already been mentioned, or that the person you are speaking to knows about

examples.x: I'd like an ice cream. Are you having one, too?
Our car's always breaking down. But we're getting a new one soon.
She was wearing her new dress, the red one.
Steve's the one with the blue jacket.
My favourite band? Oh, that's a hard one (= a hard question).
What made you choose the one rather than the other?
How about those ones over there?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để tránh lặp lại một danh từ, khi bạn đang đề cập đến ai đó/điều gì đó đã được đề cập trước đó, hoặc mà người bạn đang nói chuyện biết về

senses.definition: used when you are identifying the person or thing you are talking about

examples.x: Our house is the one next to the school.
The students who are most successful are usually the ones who come to all the classes.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng khi bạn đang xác định người hoặc vật mà bạn đang nói đến

senses.definition: a person or thing belonging to a particular group

examples.x: It's a present for one of my children.
We think of you as one of the family.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật thuộc một nhóm cụ thể

senses.definition: a person of the type mentioned

examples.x: 10 o’clock is too late for the little ones.
He ached to be home with his loved ones.
She was never one to criticize.

senses.definition_vi: một người thuộc loại được đề cập

senses.definition: used to mean ‘people in general’ or ‘I’, when the speaker is referring to himself or herself

examples.x: One should never criticize if one is not sure of one's facts.
One gets the impression that they disapprove.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để có nghĩa là 'mọi người nói chung' hoặc 'tôi', khi người nói đang đề cập đến bản thân mình

senses.definition: a person whose behaviour is funny or surprising

examples.x: Oh, you are a one!

senses.definition_vi: một người có hành vi hài hước hoặc đáng ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: the joke

examples.x: Have you heard the one about the Englishman, the Irishman and the Scotsman?

senses.definition_vi: trò đùa

senses.definition: to be a person who enjoys something, or who does something often or well

examples.x: I've never been a great one for fish and chips.

senses.definition_vi: là một người thích điều gì đó, hoặc làm điều gì đó thường xuyên hoặc giỏi

senses.definition: continuing to exist or develop

examples.x: an ongoing debate/discussion/process
The police investigation is ongoing.
Training is part of our ongoing career development program.

senses.definition_vi: tiếp tục tồn tại hoặc phát triển

senses.definition: a round vegetable with many layers inside each other and a brown, red or white skin. Onions have a strong smell and taste.

examples.x: Chop the onions finely.
French onion soup
slice/fry/peel an onion
Pile golden caramelized onions on top of mashed potatoes.

senses.definition_vi: một loại rau tròn với nhiều lớp bên trong nhau và vỏ màu nâu, đỏ hoặc trắng. Hành có mùi và vị mạnh.

senses.definition: available on or done using the internet or other computer network

examples.x: Online shopping is both cheap and convenient.
online stores/services/retailers
online dating/gaming/banking
He spends hours playing online games.
The online community is a place where customers with similar interests meet to interact.
All this information is now online.

senses.definition_vi: có sẵn trên hoặc được thực hiện bằng internet hoặc mạng máy tính khác

senses.definition: connected to the internet; able to connect to the internet

examples.x: You can see which of your friends are online and send them messages.
It's estimated that five billion users are now online.

senses.definition_vi: được kết nối với internet; có khả năng kết nối với internet

senses.definition: onto the internet; using the internet or other computer network

examples.x: Many children would rather go online than watch television.
Many people now do their banking online.
Some people are only happy to buy products online from businesses they know.
Your tax situation is the same whether you trade online or offline.

senses.definition_vi: lên internet; sử dụng internet hoặc mạng máy tính khác

senses.definition: in or into operation or existence

examples.x: The new system will go online this month.
More renewable energy is coming online.

senses.definition_vi: đang hoạt động hoặc tồn tại

senses.definition: used to say that no other or others of the same group exist or are there

examples.x: She's their only daughter.
We were the only people there.
His only answer was a grunt.
I was not the only one with moist eyes at the end of the film.
The only way he can express himself is through violence.
The only reason for this crisis is poor planning.
This might be the only time in my life I have this opportunity.
The only real difference between them is their packaging.
That's the only possible explanation I can find.
I have no choice. The only other option is to resign.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng không có ai hoặc những người khác cùng nhóm tồn tại hoặc có mặt

senses.definition: used to say that somebody/something is the best and you would not choose any other

examples.x: She's the only person for the job.
Joe's diner is the only place to eat when you 're staying in New York.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng ai đó/điều gì đó là tốt nhất và bạn sẽ không chọn bất kỳ ai khác

senses.definition: officially recognized but not existing in reality

examples.x: He's party leader in name only.

senses.definition_vi: được công nhận chính thức nhưng không tồn tại trong thực tế

senses.definition: used to emphasize that somebody is famous

examples.x: Here she is, the one and only Rihanna!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng ai đó nổi tiếng

senses.definition: used before mentioning a worry or problem you have with something

examples.x: I'd love to come—the only thing is I might be late.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng trước khi đề cập đến một mối lo ngại hoặc vấn đề bạn gặp phải với điều gì đó

senses.definition: nobody or nothing except

examples.x: There are only a limited number of tickets available.
The bar is for members only.
You only have to look at her to see she doesn't eat enough.
Only five people turned up.
They are second only to Nike in the sale of running shoes.
The bill will apply only to young workers.

senses.definition_vi: không ai hoặc không có gì ngoại trừ

senses.definition: in no other situation, place, etc.

examples.x: I agreed, but only because I was frightened.
Use pesticides only when necessary.
Paul has a mobile phone but uses it only in emergencies.
Children are admitted only if accompanied by an adult.

senses.definition_vi: không trong bất kỳ tình huống, địa điểm nào khác, v.v.

senses.definition: no more important, interesting, serious, etc. than

examples.x: It was only a suggestion.
Don't blame me, I'm only the messenger!
He was only teasing you.

senses.definition_vi: không quan trọng, thú vị, nghiêm trọng hơn, v.v. so với

senses.definition: no more than; no longer than

examples.x: She's only 21 and she runs her own business.
I've only ever seen her once.
Only about 20 per cent of the crop is exported.
It only took a few seconds.
It took only a few seconds.
Each offer is valid only for one day.
She confirmed that the dog incident occurred only once.

senses.definition_vi: không nhiều hơn; không dài hơn

senses.definition: not until

examples.x: We only got here yesterday.
The black-faced lion tamarin of Brazil was only recently discovered.
Only then did she realize the stress he was under.

senses.definition_vi: không cho đến khi

senses.definition: used to say that somebody can do no more than what is mentioned, although this is probably not enough

examples.x: We can only guess what happened.
He could only watch helplessly as the car plunged into the ravine.
I only hope that she never finds out.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng ai đó không thể làm gì nhiều hơn những gì được đề cập, mặc dù điều này có lẽ là không đủ

senses.definition: used to say that something will have a bad effect

examples.x: If you do that, it will only make matters worse.
Trying to reason with him only enrages him even more.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó sẽ có tác động xấu

senses.definition: used to mention something that happens immediately afterwards, especially something that is surprising, disappointing, etc.

examples.x: She turned up the driveway, only to find her way blocked.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để đề cập đến điều gì đó xảy ra ngay sau đó, đặc biệt là điều gì đó đáng ngạc nhiên, đáng thất vọng, v.v.

senses.definition: used to say that you wish something was true or that something had happened

examples.x: If only I were rich.
If only I knew her name.
If only he'd remembered to send that letter.
If only I had gone by taxi.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn ước điều gì đó là sự thật hoặc điều gì đó đã xảy ra

senses.definition: used to emphasize that something else is also true

examples.x: She not only wrote the text but also selected the illustrations.
He not only read the book, but also remembered what he had read.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng một điều khác cũng đúng

senses.definition: to be in love with only one particular person

examples.x: He's only ever had eyes for his wife.

senses.definition_vi: yêu chỉ một người cụ thể

senses.definition: not long ago/before

examples.x: We've only just arrived.

senses.definition_vi: không lâu trước đây/trước đó

senses.definition: almost not

examples.x: He only just caught the train.
I can afford it, but only just.

senses.definition_vi: hầu như không

senses.definition: very

examples.x: I was only too pleased to help.
Children can be difficult as we know only too well.

senses.definition_vi: rất

senses.definition: used to say that you will have to wait for some time to find out the result of a situation

examples.x: Only time will tell if the treatment has been successful.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn sẽ phải đợi một thời gian để biết kết quả của một tình huống

senses.definition: young people should enjoy themselves as much as possible, because they will have to work and worry later in their lives
senses.definition_vi: người trẻ nên tận hưởng bản thân càng nhiều càng tốt, bởi vì sau này họ sẽ phải làm việc và lo lắng trong cuộc sống

senses.definition: used with verbs to express movement on or to a particular place or position

examples.x: Move the books onto the second shelf.
She stepped down from the train onto the platform.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng với động từ để diễn tả sự di chuyển trên hoặc đến một địa điểm hoặc vị trí cụ thể

senses.definition: used to show that something faces in a particular direction

examples.x: The window looked out onto the terrace.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để chỉ ra rằng điều gì đó hướng về một hướng cụ thể

senses.definition: allowing things or people to go through; not closed or blocked

examples.x: A wasp flew in the open window.
She had left the door wide open.
The castle gates swung open.
The door burst open and the children rushed in.
She held the door open for them.
In spite of the snow, the roads remained open.
The mountain pass is kept open all year.
open borders
Borders between the countries are open and passports are not required.
Taylor headed the ball into the open goal.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép mọi vật hoặc người đi qua; không đóng hoặc chặn

senses.definition: with eyelids or lips apart

examples.x: She had difficulty keeping her eyes open (= because she was very tired).
He was breathing through his open mouth.
She stared at him, her mouth hanging open.

senses.definition_vi: với mí mắt hoặc môi hé ra

senses.definition: spread out; with the edges apart

examples.x: The flowers are all open now.
The book lay open on the table.
She put the money into his open hand.

senses.definition_vi: trải ra; với các cạnh cách nhau

senses.definition: not fastened or covered, so that things can easily come out or be put in

examples.x: Leave the envelope open.
The bag burst open and everything fell out.
I tried to pry open the locket.
The children ripped open the presents excitedly.

senses.definition_vi: không được cài hoặc che, để mọi vật có thể dễ dàng lấy ra hoặc đặt vào

senses.definition: not fastened

examples.x: Her coat was open.

senses.definition_vi: không được cài

senses.definition: not surrounded by anything; not closed in

examples.x: open country/countryside (= without forests, buildings, etc.)
a city with a lot of parks and wide open spaces
driving along the open road (= part of a road in the country, where you can drive fast)
We left port and headed for the open sea.

senses.definition_vi: không bị bao quanh bởi bất cứ thứ gì; không bị đóng kín

senses.definition: with no cover or roof on

examples.x: an open drain
people working in the open air (= not in a building)
The hall of the old house was open to the sky.
an open wound (= with no skin covering it)
They were living in a tent, cooking their meals on an open fire.
She sliced open the side of her thumb cutting up a tomato.
an open flame

senses.definition_vi: không có mái che hoặc trần nhà

senses.definition: if a shop, bank, business, etc. is open, it is ready for business and will allow customers or visitors to come in

examples.x: Is the museum open on Sundays?
The new store will be open in the spring.
I declare this festival open.
The bank is open for business again.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một cửa hàng, ngân hàng, doanh nghiệp, v.v. mở cửa, nó đã sẵn sàng kinh doanh và sẽ cho phép khách hàng hoặc khách đến

senses.definition: if a competition, meeting, etc. is open, anyone can enter, attend it, etc.

examples.x: an open debate/championship/scholarship
She was tried in open court (= the public could go and listen to the trial).
The debate was thrown open to the audience.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một cuộc thi, cuộc họp, v.v. mở, bất kỳ ai cũng có thể tham gia, tham dự, v.v.

senses.definition: if a competition, building, etc. is open to particular people, those people can enter it

examples.x: The competition is open to young people under the age of 18.
The house is not open to the public.
The car park is only open to residents.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một cuộc thi, tòa nhà, v.v. mở cho những người cụ thể, những người đó có thể tham gia

senses.definition: to be available and ready to use

examples.x: Is the offer still open?
I want to keep my Swiss bank account open.
What options are open to us?
My advice is to keep your options open.
We have kept the door open for future discussions.

senses.definition_vi: có sẵn và sẵn sàng để sử dụng

senses.definition: if a phone line or other channel of communication is open, it is ready to take calls, receive requests, etc.

examples.x: Lines are open 8 am to 7 pm weekdays.
It is important to keep communication channels open.
Nominations are now open for this year's Design Awards.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một đường dây điện thoại hoặc kênh liên lạc khác mở, nó sẵn sàng nhận cuộc gọi, yêu cầu, v.v.

senses.definition: likely to suffer something such as criticism, injury, etc.

examples.x: The system is open to abuse.
He has laid himself wide open to political attack.
Carlsen had left his bishop open (= not protected, in a game of chess).

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng chịu đựng điều gì đó như chỉ trích, tổn thương, v.v.

senses.definition: known to everyone; not kept hidden

examples.x: an open quarrel
We need more open government, starting with a Freedom of Information Act.
their open display of affection
His eyes showed open admiration as he looked at her.
One more border skirmish could lead to open war.

senses.definition_vi: được mọi người biết; không được giữ kín

senses.definition: honest; not keeping thoughts and feelings hidden

examples.x: a frank and open discussion
She was always open with her parents.
He was quite open about his reasons for leaving.

senses.definition_vi: trung thực; không giữ kín suy nghĩ và cảm xúc

senses.definition: willing to listen to and think about new ideas

examples.x: He was in an open frame of mind.
They are very open to new ideas.
I'm open to suggestions for what you would like to do in our classes.

senses.definition_vi: sẵn sàng lắng nghe và suy nghĩ về những ý tưởng mới

senses.definition: not yet finally decided or settled

examples.x: The race is still wide open (= anyone could win).
Which route is better remains an open question (= it is not decided).
In an interview try to ask open questions (= to which the answer is not just ‘yes’ or ‘no’).

senses.definition_vi: chưa được quyết định hoặc giải quyết dứt điểm

senses.definition: allowing something; making something possible

examples.x: The price is not open to negotiation.
Some phrases in the contract are open to interpretation.
What she means precisely is open to debate.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép điều gì đó; làm cho điều gì đó có thể

senses.definition: that does not have to be used on a particular day

examples.x: I have an open ticket, so I can travel any day I like.
I didn't know how long I would be staying so I bought an open return.

senses.definition_vi: không phải sử dụng vào một ngày cụ thể

senses.definition: with wide spaces between the threads

examples.x: an open weave

senses.definition_vi: với khoảng cách rộng giữa các sợi

senses.definition: produced with the tongue in the lowest possible position
senses.definition_vi: được phát ra với lưỡi ở vị trí thấp nhất có thể

senses.definition: if something is an open secret, many people know about it, although it is supposed to be a secret
senses.definition_vi: nếu một điều gì đó là bí mật công khai, nhiều người biết về nó, mặc dù nó được cho là một bí mật

senses.definition: to open suddenly or violently; to make something open in this way

examples.x: The door burst open.
Firefighters burst the door open and rescued them.

senses.definition_vi: mở ra đột ngột hoặc dữ dội; làm cho cái gì đó mở ra theo cách này

senses.definition: (to provide) the means of getting or reaching something; (to create) the opportunity for something

examples.x: The agreement will open the door to increased international trade.
Our courses are the door to success in English.

senses.definition_vi: (cung cấp) phương tiện để có được hoặc đạt được điều gì đó; (tạo ra) cơ hội cho điều gì đó

senses.definition: to be willing to listen to or accept new ideas or suggestions

examples.x: Try to keep an open mind until you've heard all the facts.

senses.definition_vi: sẵn sàng lắng nghe hoặc chấp nhận những ý tưởng hoặc đề xuất mới

senses.definition: to listen or look out for somebody/something that you might hear or see
senses.definition_vi: lắng nghe hoặc để mắt tới ai đó/điều gì đó mà bạn có thể nghe hoặc nhìn thấy

senses.definition: to look for somebody/something while you are doing other things

examples.x: Police have asked residents to keep an eye out for anything suspicious.
I walked around the store, keeping an eye out for bargains.

senses.definition_vi: tìm kiếm ai đó/điều gì đó trong khi bạn đang làm những việc khác

senses.definition: to avoid making a decision now so that you still have a choice in the future

examples.x: At the moment I'm keeping my options open and applying for as many different jobs as possible.

senses.definition_vi: tránh đưa ra quyết định bây giờ để bạn vẫn còn lựa chọn trong tương lai

senses.definition: available to buy without any limits
senses.definition_vi: có sẵn để mua mà không có bất kỳ giới hạn nào

senses.definition: if you describe somebody or their life as an open book, you mean that you can easily understand them and know everything about them
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn mô tả ai đó hoặc cuộc sống của họ như một cuốn sách mở, bạn có nghĩa là bạn có thể dễ dàng hiểu họ và biết mọi thứ về họ

senses.definition: an invitation to somebody to visit you at any time
senses.definition_vi: lời mời ai đó đến thăm bạn bất cứ lúc nào

senses.definition: if something is an open invitation to criminals, etc., it encourages them to commit a crime by making it easier

examples.x: Leaving your camera on the seat in the car is an open invitation to thieves.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một lời mời công khai dành cho tội phạm, v.v., nó khuyến khích họ phạm tội bằng cách làm cho điều đó dễ dàng hơn

senses.definition: fully aware of the possible problems or results of a particular course of action

examples.x: I went into this with my eyes open so I guess I only have myself to blame.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn nhận thức được những vấn đề hoặc kết quả có thể xảy ra của một hành động cụ thể

senses.definition: if you welcome somebody with open arms, you are extremely happy and pleased to see them
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn chào đón ai đó bằng vòng tay rộng mở, bạn cực kỳ vui mừng và hài lòng khi gặp họ

senses.definition: to move a door, window, lid, etc. into a position that is no longer closed; to get into this position

examples.x: Mr Chen opened the car door for his wife.
She opened all the windows wide to let some fresh air in.
He opened the lid of the piano.
Do you have a key that opens this gate?

senses.definition_vi: vượt qua một giai đoạn hoặc tình huống khó khăn cụ thể

senses.definition: because of or relating to something; about something

examples.x: an argument over money
a disagreement over the best way to proceed

senses.definition_vi: bởi vì hoặc liên quan đến cái gì; về cái gì

senses.definition: using something; by means of something

examples.x: We heard it over the radio.
She wouldn't tell me over the phone.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng cái gì; bằng phương tiện của cái gì

senses.definition: louder than something

examples.x: I couldn't hear what he said over the noise of the traffic.

senses.definition_vi: to hơn cái gì

senses.definition: in addition to something

examples.x: There are other factors over and above those we have discussed.

senses.definition_vi: ngoài cái gì

senses.definition: including all the things or people that are involved in a particular situation; general

examples.x: There will be winners in each of three age groups, and one overall winner.
the overall effect/picture/impression
When she finished painting, she stepped back to admire the overall effect.
The coach is happy with the overall performance of the team this season.
The overall quality of the articles is good.
The overall cost of my trip is £171.40.
a steady fall in overall crime rates
an overall result/impact/aim/strategy
the person with overall responsibility for the project
an overall improvement in standards of living (= affecting everyone)
The overall result is impressive.

senses.definition_vi: bao gồm tất cả những thứ hoặc người có liên quan trong một tình huống cụ thể; chung chung

senses.definition: including everything or everyone; in total

examples.x: The company will invest $1.6m overall in new equipment.
Last season he came second overall in the South African championships.
She kept the lead and won overall.

senses.definition_vi: bao gồm tất cả mọi thứ hoặc mọi người; tổng cộng

senses.definition: generally; when you consider everything

examples.x: Overall, this is a very useful book.
I think overall we're doing a good job.
Students were satisfied overall with what they had achieved.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn chung; khi bạn xem xét mọi thứ

senses.definition: to succeed in dealing with or controlling a problem that has been preventing you from achieving something

examples.x: She overcame injury to win the Olympic gold medal.
The two parties managed to overcome their differences on the issue.
He finally managed to overcome his fear of flying
He overcame a strong temptation to run away.

senses.definition_vi: thành công trong việc giải quyết hoặc kiểm soát một vấn đề đã ngăn cản bạn đạt được điều gì đó

senses.definition: to defeat somebody

examples.x: In the final game Sweden easily overcame France.

senses.definition_vi: đánh bại ai đó

senses.definition: to affect somebody very strongly

examples.x: Her parents were overcome with grief at the funeral.
Overcome by curiosity, the boy looked through the window.
The dead woman had been overcome by smoke.

senses.definition_vi: ảnh hưởng đến ai đó rất mạnh mẽ

senses.definition: to fail to see or notice something

examples.x: He seems to have overlooked one important fact.
In my hurry to finish the exam I had overlooked part of one of the questions.

senses.definition_vi: không nhìn thấy hoặc không nhận thấy điều gì đó

senses.definition: to see something wrong or bad but decide to ignore it

examples.x: We could not afford to overlook such a serious offence.
He’s so friendly people are prepared to overlook his faults.
I was prepared to overlook her mistakes this time.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn thấy điều gì đó sai hoặc xấu nhưng quyết định phớt lờ nó

senses.definition: if a building, etc. overlooks a place, you can see that place from the building

examples.x: a restaurant overlooking the lake
Our back yard is overlooked by several houses.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một tòa nhà, v.v. nhìn ra một địa điểm, bạn có thể nhìn thấy địa điểm đó từ tòa nhà

senses.definition: to not consider somebody for a job or position, even though they might be suitable

examples.x: She's been overlooked for promotion several times.

senses.definition_vi: không xem xét ai đó cho một công việc hoặc vị trí, mặc dù họ có thể phù hợp

senses.definition: too; very

examples.x: I'm not overly fond of pasta.
We think you are being overly optimistic.

senses.definition_vi: quá; rất

senses.definition: during or for the night

examples.x: We stayed overnight in London after the theatre.

senses.definition_vi: trong hoặc suốt đêm

senses.definition: suddenly or quickly

examples.x: Don't expect it to improve overnight.
She became famous overnight.

senses.definition_vi: đột ngột hoặc nhanh chóng

senses.definition: connected with foreign countries, especially those separated from your country by the sea or ocean

examples.x: The firm is expanding into overseas markets.
overseas development/trade
overseas visitors/students
This was her first overseas trip as prime minister.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến các quốc gia nước ngoài, đặc biệt là những quốc gia cách biệt với quốc gia của bạn bởi biển hoặc đại dương

senses.definition: to or in a foreign country, especially those separated from your country by the sea or ocean

examples.x: to live/work/go overseas
The product is sold both at home and overseas.
He was working overseas for an oil company.

senses.definition_vi: đến hoặc ở một quốc gia nước ngoài, đặc biệt là những quốc gia cách biệt với quốc gia của bạn bởi biển hoặc đại dương

senses.definition: to watch somebody/something and make sure that a job or an activity is done correctly

examples.x: United Nations observers oversaw the elections.

senses.definition_vi: quan sát ai đó/cái gì và đảm bảo rằng một công việc hoặc hoạt động được thực hiện đúng cách

senses.definition: if something overturns, or if somebody overturns it, it turns into a position in which the top of it is where the bottom of it normally is or on its side

examples.x: The car skidded and overturned.
He stood up quickly, overturning his chair.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một cái gì đó bị lật đổ, hoặc nếu ai đó lật đổ nó, nó sẽ xoay chuyển sang một vị trí mà phần trên của nó ở nơi mà phần dưới của nó thường ở hoặc nghiêng sang một bên

senses.definition: to officially decide that a legal decision, etc. is not correct, and to make it no longer legally recognized

examples.x: to overturn a decision/conviction/verdict
His sentence was overturned by the appeal court.
He hopes that councillors will overturn the decision.

senses.definition_vi: chính thức quyết định rằng một quyết định pháp lý, v.v. là không chính xác, và làm cho nó không còn được công nhận về mặt pháp lý

senses.definition: to show that a belief or an idea is not correct

examples.x: She completely overturned my preconceptions about film stars.
This argument seems convincing, but is easily overturned.

senses.definition_vi: chứng tỏ rằng một niềm tin hoặc một ý tưởng là không chính xác

senses.definition: to have such a strong emotional effect on somebody that it is difficult for them to resist or know how to react

examples.x: She was overwhelmed by feelings of guilt.
The beauty of the landscape overwhelmed me.

senses.definition_vi: có tác động cảm xúc mạnh mẽ đến ai đó đến mức khó có thể chống cự hoặc biết phải phản ứng thế nào

senses.definition: to defeat somebody completely

examples.x: The army was overwhelmed by the rebels.
He totally overwhelmed the Spaniard, 6–2, 6–3,6–2, in the final.

senses.definition_vi: đánh bại ai đó hoàn toàn

senses.definition: to be so bad or so great that a person cannot deal with it; to give too much of a thing to a person

examples.x: We were overwhelmed by requests for information.

senses.definition_vi: quá tệ hoặc quá lớn đến mức một người không thể đối phó được; cung cấp quá nhiều thứ cho một người

senses.definition: to cover somebody/something completely

examples.x: The wave broke through the wall and overwhelmed the town.

senses.definition_vi: bao phủ hoàn toàn ai đó/cái gì

senses.definition: very great or very strong; so powerful that you cannot resist it or decide how to react

examples.x: The evidence against him was overwhelming.
The overwhelming majority of those present were in favour of the plan.
an overwhelming sense of loss
She had the almost overwhelming desire to tell him the truth.
You may find it somewhat overwhelming at first.
There was overwhelming support for our policies.

senses.definition_vi: rất lớn hoặc rất mạnh; quá mạnh đến mức bạn không thể chống cự hoặc quyết định cách phản ứng

senses.definition: to have to pay somebody for something that you have already received or return money that you have borrowed

examples.x: She still owes her father £3 000.
I'm still owed three days' leave.
He owes more money than he can afford to pay.
Exactly how much do we owe?
She still owes £3 000 to her father.
The country owes billions of dollars to foreign creditors.

examples.cf: owe something to somebody for something
examples.x: Most hospitals owe money to pharmaceutical companies for medicines and equipment.
How much do I owe you for the groceries?

senses.definition_vi: phải trả tiền cho ai đó vì bạn đã nhận được hoặc trả lại tiền bạn đã vay

senses.definition: to feel that you ought to do something for somebody or give them something, especially because they have done something for you

examples.x: I owe a debt of gratitude to all my family.
You owe it to your staff to be honest with them.
I owe a duty to my family.
You owe me a favour!
Thanks for sticking up for me—I owe you one (= I owe you a favour).
I think you owe us an explanation.
I think we're owed an apology.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy rằng bạn có nghĩa vụ phải làm điều gì đó cho ai đó hoặc cho họ một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là vì họ đã làm điều gì đó cho bạn

senses.definition: to exist or be successful because of the help or influence of somebody/something

examples.x: He owes his success to hard work.
The play owes much to French tragedy.
I owe everything to him.
The town owes its existence to the minerals that lie below the mountains.
I owe him everything.
I knew that I owed the surgeon my life.

senses.definition_vi: tồn tại hoặc thành công nhờ sự giúp đỡ hoặc ảnh hưởng của ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have to obey and support somebody who is in a position of authority or power

examples.x: All serfs owed allegiance to a lord.

senses.definition_vi: phải tuân theo và ủng hộ người có quyền lực hoặc vị thế cao hơn

senses.definition: used to emphasize that something belongs to or is connected with somebody

examples.x: It was her own idea.
I saw it with my own eyes (= I didn't hear about it from somebody else).
Is the car your own?
Your day off is your own (= you can spend it as you wish).
He desperately wants to live his own life (= be independent and do whatever he wants).
Our children are grown up and have children of their own.
For reasons of his own (= particular reasons that perhaps only he knew about), he refused to join the club.
The accident happened through no fault of her own.
He wants to come into the business on his own terms.
I need a room of my own.
I have my very own room at last.
their own personal/unique/private beliefs
He was determined to go his own way.
I was almost completely in my own little world.
Most people want to live in their own homes as they age.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng điều gì đó thuộc về hoặc liên quan đến ai đó

senses.definition: done or produced by and for yourself

examples.x: She makes all her own clothes.
He has to cook his own meals.

senses.definition_vi: được thực hiện hoặc tạo ra bởi và cho chính bạn

senses.definition: to have the opportunity to show how good or useful you are or something is

examples.x: When the traffic's this bad, a bicycle really comes into its own.

senses.definition_vi: có cơ hội thể hiện bạn giỏi hoặc hữu ích như thế nào hoặc điều gì đó hữu ích như thế nào

senses.definition: bad people often seem to have good luck
senses.definition_vi: người xấu thường dường như gặp may mắn

senses.definition: to do something to somebody in return for harm they have done to you; to get revenge

examples.x: I'll get my own back on him one day, I swear!

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó với ai đó để đáp lại tổn hại mà họ đã gây ra cho bạn; trả thù

senses.definition: to have your own opinion and make your own decisions without being influenced by other people

examples.x: She has a mind of her own and isn't afraid to say what she thinks.
My computer seems to have a mind of its own!

senses.definition_vi: có ý kiến riêng và đưa ra quyết định của riêng mình mà không bị người khác ảnh hưởng

senses.definition: to remain in a strong position when somebody is attacking you, competing with you, etc.

examples.x: Business isn't good but we're managing to hold our own.
She can hold her own against anybody in an argument.
The patient is holding her own although she is still very sick.

senses.definition_vi: duy trì vị thế vững chắc khi ai đó tấn công bạn, cạnh tranh với bạn, v.v.

senses.definition: because of your personal qualifications or efforts, not because of your connection with somebody else

examples.x: She sings with a rock band, but she's also a jazz musician in her own right.

senses.definition_vi: do trình độ hoặc nỗ lực cá nhân của bạn, không phải do mối liên hệ của bạn với người khác

senses.definition: to like talking a lot or too much, usually without wanting to listen to other people

examples.x: She’s much too fond of the sound of her own voice.

senses.definition_vi: thích nói nhiều hoặc quá nhiều, thường là không muốn lắng nghe người khác

senses.definition: alone; without anyone else

examples.x: I'm all on my own today.
She lives on her own.

senses.definition_vi: một mình; không có ai khác

senses.definition: without help

examples.x: He did it on his own.

Don’t tell me what to do—you don’t own me!
His father was a farmer who owned land and property.
He owns and operates an eco-tourism company.
Hospitals became publicly owned companies.

senses.definition: to manage and take responsibility for something

examples.x: The successful candidate will be responsible for owning and achieving sales targets.

senses.definition_vi: quản lý và chịu trách nhiệm về điều gì đó

examples.x: She owned the stage, performing a medley of hit songs.
He didn't just finish the course, he completely owned it.
Yeah right, she totally owned you, man!

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn thành công, đặc biệt là trong một cuộc thi; đánh bại hoàn toàn ai đó

senses.definition: to admit that something is true

examples.x: He owned to a feeling of guilt.
She owned (that) she had been present.

senses.definition_vi: thừa nhận rằng điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: to behave in a very confident way that annoys other people, for example by telling them what to do

examples.x: She was acting as if she owned the place.

senses.definition_vi: hành xử một cách rất tự tin khiến người khác khó chịu, ví dụ bằng cách bảo họ phải làm gì

senses.definition: a person who owns something

examples.x: a dog/pet/gun owner
a business/property/store owner
The painting has been returned to its rightful owner.
He's now the proud owner of a cottage in Wales.
Would the owner of the black Mercedes parked in front of the gates please report to reception.
They were using the land with the permission of the owner.

senses.definition_vi: người sở hữu một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the fact of owning something

examples.x: a growth in home ownership
Ownership of the land is currently being disputed.
to be in joint/private/public ownership
The restaurant is under new ownership.

senses.definition_vi: việc sở hữu một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a chemical element. Oxygen is a gas that is present in air and water and is necessary for people, animals and plants to live.

examples.x: The patient didn't seem to be getting enough oxygen.

senses.definition_vi: một nguyên tố hóa học. Oxy là một loại khí có trong không khí và nước, cần thiết cho sự sống của con người, động vật và thực vật.
